findings.finding: CDF1/CDF2 magic is checked before the reviewed SciPy NetCDF3 reader. Each family member requires full425-node/256-cell dimensions, explicit positive unique node_num_map/elem_num_map, block IDs/status, ordered HEX8 rows, coordinates/times/named nodal fields. Native map-minus1 is a predeclared writer policy verified by exact source ID/coordinate words and sampler IDs, never inferred from coordinates. Family names are closed over all matching/possibly unsupported Exodus artifacts; missing or ambiguous frames/blocks/IDs refuse.

Positive native reference-corner order and complete distinct Cartesian boxes enforce the fixed grid. Basis N=product(1+s*xi)/8, physical derivative s_j*product(other factors)/(4*width_j), and weight volume/8 are correct. Eight physical positions are joined to observed QP IDs without assuming enumeration; stable repeated ID/coordinate words are required. 80*128*8+81*256*8=247808 rows per phase, 495616 total; all30 components are checked for all active rows.

Old material uses symgrad(u) and400K. Born cells use symgrad(u-u_BEGIN80) with the captured displacement configuration and actual original BEGIN80 temperature on all225 born nodes, including25 shared nodes. Shared current displacement/temperature and prior-END tensor states are checked before each next solve;200 newly activated nodes require zero captured displacement and newborn BEGIN80 tensors require zero. Reference225 stays immutable afterbirth. No uniform350K/shared-node assumption, cooling history or globally-zero born displacement reference is substituted. Old/older solution-vector rebasing remains pinned source semantics and checked consequences, not a direct vector observation.

Three-dimensional isotropic Hooke stress uses mu=E/(2(1+nu)), lambda=E*nu/((1+nu)*(1-2nu)); thermal eigenstrain is alpha*(T-Tref)*I, elastic/mechanical strain=total-eigenstrain. Tensor shear is symmetrized, not engineering gamma. All5 tensors and BEGIN-to-END increments are compared; strain/stress gates remain separate. E71e9Pa/nu.33/alpha1e-5 are fixed research hypotheses bound to the authored card.

All8-GP sigma_ij*dNa/dxj*dV contributions from old and born domains are assembled into a common nodal force map before any free-component test. Separate subset interface rows are not treated as free. Independent/original-QP force assemblies agree; each unconstrained component vanishes. Six rigid-mode constraints join exact source IDs/positions; END rx/ry/rz match full internal forces. Both all-node and constrained-only force/moment resultants are checked in SI. Energy is finite/nonnegative diagnostic only; no work=2U shortcut or serial-bar oracle is used.

Temperature1e-10K, displacement1e-12m, QP-coordinate2e-13m, strain1e-10, stress0.1Pa, force1e-7N and moment1e-7Nm apply to every finite scalar without relative fallback/sampling/tuning. These are predeclared numerical study gates, not a roundoff guarantee or physical error budget; first native data may fail and must remain preserved.
